actualDeviceEvidence.observation: Application startup main thread blocked on PhoneObservationSpool monitor held by journal ingest readState/hash/String.format. Slow software-emulated CPU/scheduling amplified the stall.

changes: PhoneEventJournal.hash uses the same SHA-256 and lowercase hex bytes without per-byte Formatter allocation.
PhoneObservationSpool.readState reads atomically published complete files without the global spool monitor; checksum validation is retained.
Concurrent state read caches publish with putIfAbsent so newer persisted puts win.
Backup restore publishes a fresh cache map so in-flight old readers cannot refill the restored cache.

tests.baseline: startup-read-baseline.log: 5 tests, 3 expected failures (monitor wait, newer put overwritten, restored cache contaminated).
tests.after: startup-read-after.log: 27/27 pass, new startup suite plus existing journal-spool and archive-compaction suites.
tests.runner: Direct javac/JUnit against changed production classes and existing compiled dependencies; no Gradle or ADB invoked by this agent.

limits: Rebuilt APK startup/ANR recurrence is awaiting coordinator/device reviewer verification.
Initial small disk reads still occur on main; this patch does not redesign application initialization.
No archive, observation or database rows are discarded by the patch.
